# Draft retained-column experiment fixtures

`cases.json` is copied byte-for-byte from Spec Draft RFC 0029 at
`dd2cc94461950563729d1bbf672d785afeb1b02c`, path
`rfcs/retained-column-conversion/cases.json`.
SHA-256: `c443229939deafc1c3f5020a9b3e9bdcd69707bc3a42c9571a6a59f81dfaa69d`.
The adjacent upstream structural schema has SHA-256
`e67a1cb62d826292f75dde89889cc46a78e987dfab56cc7325584d10e038f093`.
These are handwritten Draft expectations, not outputs recorded from this package.
No upstream reader implementation is copied.

The package tests consume all 72 compatibility descriptions (71 record previews
and one row-free plan acceptance), seven fixed type bounds, seven shortest-decimal
probes, and the nine object-shaped lineage requests. Other interface requests in
the retained complete corpus concern capability admission, original carrier
restoration, or a prototype line protocol and are outside this package. Their
presence is not a claim that they executed here. Local tests separately handwrite
parser, profile, original-revision, raw-lineage and canonical-boundary regressions.

This package is an internal pure foundation. It exposes no public capability or
route and does not produce or verify a preparation. The complete producer,
carrier/transport budgets, original inventory commitments, generated review,
shared preparation integration, independent review, full integrated checks, CI,
adoption and immutable release gates remain with their respective owners.
